Lemma
[Rigidity of the optimal isoperimetric constant] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0107, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0108 ↗ lem:chow-iv-isoperimetric-minimizers 1. ch29:29.19\group Isoperimetry

If $I(\widetilde g)=4\pi $, then $\widetilde g$ is round. If a Ricci flow on $S^2$ has isoperimetric constant $4\pi $ at one time, then it is a round shrinking solution.
